title: "I will fight no more forever": 19 different versions #Shorts
description:
"From where the sun now stands, I will fight no more forever." The words were written down and rewritten by an Army officer. One historian counted nineteen published versions.

▶ Full documentary (Part 3, 13 Days in Yellowstone: The Nez Perce, 1877): https://youtu.be/jbZbPS173wc

#Shorts #Yellowstone #NationalParks #History
